tools.name: Merge PDFs
tools.description: Combine several PDFs into one document in a chosen order.

tools.name: Split PDF
tools.description: Split by page ranges, fixed chunks, single pages or maximum output size.

tools.name: Organise pages
tools.description: Visually reorder, rotate, duplicate and delete pages with live thumbnails.

tools.name: Rotate PDF
tools.description: Rotate selected pages by 90, 180 or 270 degrees.

tools.name: Extract pages
tools.description: Keep only the chosen pages in a clean output document.

tools.name: Crop / trim
tools.description: Remove margins and rebuild pages at the trimmed size.

tools.name: Resize pages
tools.description: Fit or fill pages to A4, A3, A5, Letter or Legal.

tools.name: Multiple pages per sheet
tools.description: Impose 2, 4, 6 or 9 pages per sheet with optional borders.

tools.name: Booklet imposition
tools.description: Create saddle-stitch sheets for double-sided printing.

tools.name: Watermark
tools.description: Stamp text or an image, tiled or centred, with rotation and opacity.

tools.name: Page numbers
tools.description: Add custom page numbers with position, format and starting value.

tools.name: Header & footer
tools.description: Add running headers or footers with tokens for page, total, date and title.

tools.name: Bates numbering
tools.description: Apply legal sequential Bates stamps with a configurable prefix.

tools.name: Sign & stamp
tools.description: Draw, type or upload a signature and place it on any page.

tools.name: Annotate & mark up
tools.description: Add text notes, highlights, rectangles and freehand ink.

tools.name: Fill forms
tools.description: Complete AcroForm fields and optionally flatten the result.

tools.name: Metadata
tools.description: Rewrite or remove title, author, subject, keywords and producer.

tools.name: Clean & repair
tools.description: Flatten, sanitize or rebuild documents to fix structure and strip hidden data.

tools.name: PDF to images
tools.description: Render pages to PNG, JPEG or WebP at up to 600 DPI.

tools.name: Images to PDF
tools.description: Combine JPG, PNG, WebP and AVIF images into a paginated PDF.

tools.name: PDF to text
tools.description: Extract the document text layer page by page.

tools.name: PDF to HTML
tools.description: Build a clean, self-contained HTML reading page.

tools.name: PDF to Markdown
tools.description: Convert paragraphs and headings into Markdown.

tools.name: PDF to JSON
tools.description: Export pages, sizes, metadata and text as structured JSON.

tools.name: Text / Markdown to PDF
tools.description: Typeset plain text or Markdown with Unicode and Greek support.

tools.name: Convert to PDF/A
tools.description: Produce PDF/A-2b or PDF/A-3b archive files.

tools.name: Compress PDF
tools.description: Recompress images or rewrite the file losslessly to reduce size.

tools.name: Grayscale PDF
tools.description: Convert colour documents to neutral grayscale.

tools.name: OCR — searchable PDF
tools.description: Recognise scanned text on device and add an invisible text layer.

tools.name: Protect with password
tools.description: Encrypt with AES-256 and set printing, copy and editing permissions.

tools.name: Remove password
tools.description: Create an unencrypted copy of a document you own.

tools.name: Redact
tools.description: Permanently remove selected areas by rebuilding the page without them.

tools.name: Document inspector
tools.description: Inspect pages, sizes, fonts, scripts, attachments and metadata.

tools.name: Compare versions
tools.description: Compare two documents side by side with a per-page pixel difference.
